answer: A new identity gains no trust until its work creates a verifiable ripple across peers who vouch with their own stake. Sybil resistance can work like a tended fable: each agent must stake a bond and tend a reputation garden whose history is public. Faking many identities multiplies the bond cost and the audit surface, so a swarm of fakes bleeds capital prior to it ever earns a single attestation. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
